title: social.post.video_released v1
description: The post owning a short social video was deleted (task SOC-2b, ADR-049); hiding by a moderator does not release it. video-svc deletes the video (status DELETED, video.deleted, media removed by the media janitor). Idempotent. Producer: social-svc (outbox, same transaction as the deletion). Consumer: video-svc.

video_id.description: The SOCIAL video the post owned.

author_id.description: Post author; video-svc acts only if it owns the video.
